title: India Pulse: choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Pump Price Board. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Pump Price Board
options.lineage: Indian fuel-station price totems and canopy fascia
options.thesis: Every indicator is posted like the rate board at a fuel station: big tabular digits on enamel panels, revised in place each morning.
options.viewport: Top bar with city picker and date. Four enamel panels (Fuel, Gold, Thali, AQI), each a price-board stack of rows with large digits, Δd/Δw and a 90-day line. A movers strip and a cross-city ranked board sit below.
options.risk: If the digits are rendered as glowing LEDs it slides into neon; it has to stay as daylight enamel.

raised.raise: Data state is drawn as line form, not hue: real quotes are solid, reconstructed history is dashed, stale data is half-tone.
One reserved colour marks the selected city across every panel, chart and ranking, and nothing else uses it.
Every board shares one strict column grid, so digits align across panels and the page scans like a single posted board.

options.label: RBI Statistical Handbook
options.lineage: RBI Handbook of Statistics and government statistical bulletins
options.thesis: India's daily street-level data set like an official statistical table: ruled, numbered and footnoted down to its provenance.
options.viewport: Four table-panels in a 2x2 grid, each a numbered statistical table with a sparkline column and source footnotes. The alert rail runs on the right.
options.risk: Familiar: it lands near the editorial broadsheet look many finance dashboards already wear.

options.label: Departure Board
options.lineage: airport gate boards and boarding passes
options.thesis: Cities rank like departures, and a revised price stays lit until you have seen it.
options.viewport: Four indicator panels, each a ranked board of cities. Changed rows hold a yellow mark until acknowledged.
options.case: Fuses well: reranking and persistent change state fit the morning scan, but traders identify with it less than with fuel-station boards.
options.risk: A dark board can drift toward a terminal costume.

options.label: Emission-Line Rail
options.thesis: Values as hairlines on one calibrated rail.
options.viewport: One rail per indicator with cities as ticks.
options.risk: Too abstract for a quick scan.
options.case: Loses on audience identification and clarity.
options.kept: State as line form: solid real, dashed reconstructed.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: Terrain colours with one purple course.
options.viewport: City map with a course overlay.
options.risk: A map adds nothing for 20 cities.
options.kept: One reserved colour for the active selection.

options.label: Vertical Feed
options.kept: Preloading the next state so switching is instant.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A TradingView/Koyfin-style grid of KPI cards with sparklines, a main chart and a watchlist table, executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Four KPI cards, a main chart with the stock overlay, and a city table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any market dashboard by design.
